description: To combat Bidenflation and rising costs, we must practice fiscal discipline in Montgomery and eliminate wasteful spending. This allows us to let Alabama families and businesses keep more of their hard-earned money through lower taxes. Slashing job-killing regulations is essential to unleashing innovation and building a robust economy.
